canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Maison Colette

parent.title: A Maison Colette weekend in Tongerlo

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Maison Colette
siblings.summary: Where to sleep within a 20-minute taxi of Maison Colette — from the restaurant's own 5 dinner-bundled rooms to a 17th-century watermill, a former Carmelite convent, and a forester's house in the woods.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Maison Colette
siblings.summary: What to see, walk, cycle, eat and drink inside a 30 km ring around Maison Colette — from the Tongerlo Last Supper to UNESCO beguinages, Averbode heath, Bobbejaanland and the Café Trappisten.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Maison Colette
siblings.summary: Leuven and Mechelen meetups sit inside 30 km of Tongerlo; the headliner Antwerp conferences (Techorama, Devoxx, DDD Europe, BC TechDays) sit 35-47 km out but are still <50 min by car.

sources.title: Maison Colette — overnight stay
sources.claim: 5 luxurious on-site rooms at €305/room incl. breakfast; bookable only with a dinner reservation; check-in 16:00–18:00, check-out by 10:30.

sources.title: Maison Colette — contact
sources.claim: De Trannoyplein 17, 2260 Westerlo (Tongerlo), Belgium.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Maison Colette
sources.claim: Two Michelin stars; five deluxe guestrooms attached to the restaurant.

sources.title: Toerisme Westerlo — overnachten
sources.claim: Full set of accommodations in the municipality.

sources.title: B&B Villa Zonneweelde
sources.claim: Langstraat 70, 2260 Westerlo-Tongerlo — authentic 1947 manor with garden; 'within walking distance of Tongerlo Abbey'.

sources.title: B&B Carpe Diem
sources.claim: Kaaibeeksedijk 6, Westerlo; 2 rooms with WiFi, smart TV, Auping bed, AC, terrace.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Carpe Diem reviews
sources.claim: Travelers' Choice; 5/5; rates ~$131–$203 per night.

sources.title: B&B Butch
sources.claim: Ter Voort 238, Westerlo; €95 per night double incl. breakfast; cyclist-oriented.

sources.title: B&B Crea Els
sources.claim: Toekomststraat 32 (Oevel); €100 for 2 guests, €190 for 4 in 2 rooms.

sources.title: Tongerlo Abbey gastenkwartier
sources.claim: 5 single rooms (Bisschopshuis) + 4 double rooms (Prelatuur); communal refectory; multi-night minimum; no walk-ins.

sources.title: Hotel Geerts
sources.claim: 4-generation family hotel; Grote Markt 50, 2260 Westerlo; on-site restaurant, orangerie, garden.

sources.title: Hotel Geerts via 2flanders
sources.claim: 4-star, 18-room property; listed 2.1 km from Tongerlo Abbey.

sources.title: Beeltjens B&B Wolf & Belle
sources.claim: de Merodedreef 55, Westerlo; single-room B&B with walk-in shower + infrared cabin; scores 9.1–9.3.
